name: VentraConnect Social Login
author: Fahad Aslam

sections.description:
VentraConnect Social Login lets visitors sign up and sign in to your WordPress site using their existing social accounts — no passwords required.

Features
* 15+ providers for WordPress login, registration
* Shortcode support – easily embed social login buttons anywhere
* Multiple social accounts can be linked to a single user
* User account linking / unlinking in WordPress profiles
* Profile sync option — sync user profile data from social providers
* Simple per-provider credential setup (Client ID / Secret)
* Button themes/styles: Light, Dark, Minimal (with icon + text)
* Show/hide provider buttons on core WordPress forms
* Provider enable/disable toggles
* Works with standard WordPress user roles
* Diagnostics/logging for troubleshooting and support
* Fully translatable (text domain: ventraconnect-social-login)

Coming soon
* WooCommerce integration (login / checkout)
* Redirect rules, advanced styling, and analytics
* Detailed logs, role rules, and shortcodes

External services

VentraConnect Social Login is an OAuth client that connects directly to the official endpoints of each provider you enable. During login, the user’s browser is redirected to the provider (e.g. Google, Facebook, Microsoft, TikTok, Reddit, LINE, Slack, Discord, Twitch, GitHub, Amazon, Yahoo, WordPress.com, LinkedIn, etc.), they grant access, and the provider returns an authorization code/access token. The plugin then retrieves basic profile details (provider ID, email address, display name, avatar URL) in order to create or link a WordPress user. No data is sent to or stored on servers owned by the plugin author; all requests go straight from your site to the provider APIs listed below.

Provider domains used
– Google: accounts.google.com, oauth2.googleapis.com, people.googleapis.com
– Facebook: graph.facebook.com
– Microsoft: login.microsoftonline.com, graph.microsoft.com
– TikTok: open.tiktokapis.com
– Reddit: www.reddit.com, oauth.reddit.com
– LINE: access.line.me, api.line.me
– Slack: slack.com
– Discord: discord.com
– Twitch: id.twitch.tv, api.twitch.tv
– GitHub: github.com, api.github.com
– Amazon: www.amazon.com, api.amazon.com
– Yahoo: api.login.yahoo.com
– WordPress.com: public-api.wordpress.com
– LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com, api.linkedin.com

Each provider maintains its own Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. Review and comply with those documents when enabling their login option on your site.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ventraconnect-social-login folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings → VentraConnect Social Login.
  4. Choose a provider (e.g., Google or Facebook) and add your OAuth credentials.
  5. Save changes — social login buttons will appear on the WordPress login and registration screens.
sections.faq:
Where do I get OAuth credentials?

Links to provider developer consoles are available in the plugin settings.
The plugin automatically generates a proper callback URL using WordPress admin-ajax.php.
On a typical site it will look similar to:
https://example.com/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php?action=ventraconnect_sl_oauth_callback&provider=PROVIDER
but you should not hardcode this path; always use the URL shown in the plugin settings.

Does it create new user accounts?

If the email address already exists, the account is linked and the user is logged in.
If not, a new user account is created automatically.

What data is stored?

Only the provider ID, name, email, and avatar URL are stored.
Site owners can output a privacy notice using the ventraconnect_sl_privacy_notice_html filter.
